title: feat(fields, spec): show a referenceNameVisible lookup's served name as plain text, and offer its field-form row
body:
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbUkkKyWnKsQpoatsf3hYxiL)_ Fixes #29462 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Claim: 6588482199 (amendments 6588547542, 6590220295) ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:字段声明 `referenceNameVisible: true` 的 lookup / user 字段,当服务端对读者无权读取的目标返回 `{ id, name, readRefused: true }` 时,列表单元格与记录详情页把名称显示为纯文本:不带链接、不弹悬浮卡、不读取目标记录;多值字段每个元素一个文本标签。字段表单(`field` 元数据表单)新增该开关,只在 lookup 与 user 类型上显示,并补了中日西三语文案。 - 为什么改:服务端半边(#29460,PR #29576)已开始下发名称;按裁决 6574398310 字母 B,控制台要显示名称而不是「受限记录」占位,且不得链接到读者打不开的记录。 - 风险与回滚:只认带 `readRefused: true` 的值;不带该键的字段、可读目标、裸 id 的「受限记录」占位全部不变(#13335 测试原样通过)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看:`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` 的 `isReferenceNameOnly` / `ReferenceNameOnly` 与 `LookupCellRenderer`、`UserCellRenderer` 中的三处分支;`packages/spec/src/data/field.form.ts` 新增的一行。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/lookupCell.referenceNameVisible-29462.test.tsx`,预期 11 个用例全部通过。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes The console half of `FieldSchema.referenceNameVisible` (director ruling 6574398310, letter B), rendered against the shape PR #29576 serves: on `$expand`, a `lookup` / `user` field declaring the key answers a target the reader is refused as `{ id, name, readRefused: true }`, once per element on `multiple: true`, with the floor `Record #ID` under a field-level rule on the name column. | Value the cell receives | Before | Now | |---|---|---| | `{ id, name, readRefused: true }` on a `lookup` | a link to the refused record, with a hover card that reads it | the served `name` as plain text (`data-slot="reference-name-only"`), no link, no hover card, no read | | the same on a `user` | an avatar and the name | the served `name` as plain text, no avatar | | an array of those (`multiple: true`) | one linked chip / avatar per element | one text chip per element; other elements keep their faces | | an expanded record without the marker | a link | unchanged | | a bare id whose read answers "not found" (field without the key) | the restricted-record placeholder | unchanged | - `isReferenceNameOnly` judges the in-band `readRefused === true` the server writes, never the shape of the rest, so a readable record expanded with a narrow projection stays a link. - The served name is drawn as served: the viewer's policy on the target object (which is what refused the record) is not applied to it, and the field's `displayField` does not re-name it. - A value made only of served names does not ask for the referenced object's definition either (`useRefObjectSchema` gets no object), so the cell makes no read at all. - The record page's field grid (`DetailSection`) draws lookup and user values through these same cells, so it changes with them; `plugin-detail` source is untouched. - **Field form.** `packages/spec/src/data/field.form.ts` gains the `referenceNameVisible` row ("Show Name When Unreadable"), `visibleWhen: data.type in ['lookup','user']`. That predicate is also the key's parse gate: `FieldSchema` refuses the key on every other type, an authored `false` included. The `omit` ledger entry in `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` is removed with the row (the card's one spec edit). The row's label and help text are regenerated into the `platform-objects` metadata-form bundles and translated for zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES. ## Tests - `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/lookupCell.referenceNameVisible-29462.test.tsx` (new, 11): served name as text with no anchor, and a recording data source (find, findOne, getObjectSchema all answering) asked nothing, after hover and focus; the floor `Record #l1` drawn as served; `displayField` does not re-name it; `multiple: true` one chip per element; a mixed array keeps the readable element's link; `user` single and multiple; CONTROLS: a record without the marker and `readRefused: 'yes'` stay links, a field without the key keeps the restricted placeholder, an expanded user keeps its avatar. - `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.referenceNameVisible-29462.test.tsx` (new, 5): the real `DetailSection` draws lookup, user and multi-value user rows as text with no anchor, reads nothing about the refused targets, and keeps a readable sibling's link. - `packages/spec/src/data/field-form-reference-name-visible.test.ts` (new, 3): the row is declared once, its predicate shows it on `lookup` and `user` only over every `FieldType`, and that set equals the set `FieldSchema` accepts the key on. - Unchanged control: `lookupCell.restrictedRecord-13335.test.tsx` green, unmodified. - Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, WRAP mode, each restored to the HEAD blob), each red: A1 lookup single branch removed, 3 failed; A2 array element branch removed, 2 failed; A3 user single branch removed, 2 failed; A4 user array branch removed, 2 failed; A5 schema read no longer skipped, 1 failed; A6 the row's predicate widened to `master_detail`, 2 failed. ## Acceptance notes - Clause-② hint: `dispatch-gates --tier` derives no path mandate (default tier). It prints a Clause-② SUSPECT hint on `packages/spec/src/data/field.form.ts` (`packages/spec/src/**`). The row offers a key `FieldSchema` already accepts on exactly these types (the accept set does not move), so the claim's `Clause-②: no` is kept; the seat reads the hint. - Surface: the claim's eight files plus one count pin the seat added by amendment 6590220295: `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` counts metadata-form labels authored in all three locales, 699 → 700 with its comment line, as every new form row does. - The Studio object designer's field panel is the hand-written `ObjectFieldInspector`, which does not read `field.form.ts`. A live probe as the admin (lookup selected in the designer) shows no such control there. The seat files that control as its own card; this PR leaves the inspector alone. - Seen on the live server, not changed here: the same lookup WITHOUT the key, whose target the member's object gate refuses, draws the unresolved face (the id with a question mark, inside a link) rather than the restricted-record placeholder. The record read answers 403 for an object-gate refusal, and the cell reads only a "not found" answer as restricted. Reported to the seat. - Local gates on the merged head `7fb3a29d`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 85 commands; each ran with exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the verify lock), and `--ran` reconciles 85 derived, 85 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Type-checks exit 0: spec, platform-objects, and `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. Suites: spec 891/891 files (25223 tests) and fields 295 files / plugin-detail 369 files before the main merge; on the merged head platform-objects 110/110 files, spec `src/system/` plus the field-form tests 70/70 files, the four lookup/detail files 31/31, and `spec check:generated` exit 0. The repo-wide sweep (`pnpm lint` and the rest of the farm) is CI's. ## Verification Real backend and the source Console, on head `5c25e7f3` (before the main merge; this PR's cell and form code is unchanged since). Screenshots and the scripts are in the project folder (`issue-29462/shots/`, `live-setup.mjs`, `live-grant.mjs`, `live-shot.cjs`), not on GitHub.
pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh plus the Console Vite dev server, a member who may read the expense but not the payroll run - A scratch package over REST: `rnv_payroll` (`sharingModel: private`, admin-owned rows) and `rnv_expense` (`public_read`) with `payroll` (lookup, `referenceNameVisible: true`), `payroll_plain` (the same lookup without the key) and `payrolls` (`multiple: true`, with the key). A member created with `admin/create-user`, granted read on `rnv_expense` only by a package permission set, then impersonated. - `GET /api/v1/data/rnv_payroll/ID` as the member: 403. `GET /api/v1/data/rnv_expense/ID?expand=payroll,payroll_plain,payrolls` as the member: `payroll` = `{ id, name: "Payroll Q3 2026", readRefused: true }`, `payrolls` = two such values, `payroll_plain` = the bare id. As the admin, all three are the full records. - List view (`/apps/com.example.rnv/rnv_expense`) and record page, as the member: `Payroll (name visible)` reads "Payroll Q3 2026" as plain text; `Payrolls` shows two text chips "Payroll Q3 2026" and "Payroll Q4 2026"; three `reference-name-only` elements, none inside a link. Hovering each of them made no request. The only `rnv_payroll` requests on the page (one record read, one object definition read) and the only link to `rnv_payroll` belong to `Payroll (no key)`, the control field, which draws as before.
